bankTransfer.instructions: Transfer the exact order amount via UBL App or 1-Link IBFT. Keep your transfer receipt.

easypaisa.instructions: Send money via EasyPaisa App to 03008476546. Enter your 3737 TID in verification field.

jazzcash.instructions: Pay via JazzCash App to 03063300658. Provide your 12-digit transaction ID.

crypto.instructions: Transfer USDT equivalent (Rate: 1 USDT = Rs. 280). Paste your TxHash transaction hash.

sadapay.instructions: Send payment via SadaPay App to 03008476546. Enter the Reference Number or Transaction ID.
